summary: Treat AI-generated design documents as drafts by default: label provenance, require human review and explicit acceptance (ADR-style status accepted) before any generated document may be cited as specification.

evidence.summary: ADRs create a single durable source of truth per decision; decision log links to PRs/issues for traceability.
Microsoft Well-Architected guidance on maintaining an architecture decision record.
2026 SDD guide: versioned structured specifications as source of truth; community reports 60-80% fewer rework cycles vs prompt-driven development.

risks: Rubber-stamp acceptance recreates the problem; sampling audits needed.
